summary: Verified the 'Über mich' About-image fix on the static site (Express on port 3000). Mobile image ueber-mobile.webp now loads at natural 1500x1294 (52KB), HTTP 200, and renders sharply framed on the doctor at a 390x844 mobile viewport. Desktop background image intact. No console errors. Vacation popup correctly not present (June 2026).
critical_code_review_comments: Hero section: query for '#hero' returned MISSING (id likely different, e.g. 'home' or none). Not part of this bug, but confirm test-selector expectations if hero anchors are needed elsewhere.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static site served by Express at http://localhost:3000 from /app/static-website. ueber-mobile.webp is 1500x1294. Mobile img selector: '.about-mobile-image img'. Desktop uses CSS background image-set with ueber-bg.webp/png.
rca of the issue: Original ueber-mobile.webp was 876x430 causing upscale blur on mobile devices (physical pixel density > CSS size). Fix regenerated it at 1500x1294 from the 4K source, giving enough pixel density for retina mobile screens. Verified naturalWidth=1500 and image renders sharply.
